scripts.setup: docker compose up -d --wait && npm run db:migrate -w @nexo/tickets-service && npm run db:seed -w @nexo/tickets-service && npm run db:migrate -w @nexo/assist
scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n tickets,assist,web -c yellow,blue,green "npm run dev -w @nexo/tickets-service" "npm run dev -w @nexo/assist" "npm run dev -w @nexo/web"
